changelog:
- Initial release of the "devils-advocate" skill: an AI-powered decision stress-test tool.
- Runs /devil command to evaluate a real decision through a council of 5 independent AI advisors (using two model families when possible).
- Includes context gathering, automated fact lookup, fact-check pass, confidence triage, peer review, adversarial stress test, and a final verdict.
- Every non-required capability degrades gracefully; core council works with just parallel sub-agent spawning.
- Built and iteratively improved by running on real decisions and fixing observed failures.
- Clear requirements and fallbacks for missing capabilities ensure robust operation.
summary: Trigger /devil to pressure-test a decision through a multi-model council, fact-check pass, peer review, and a mandatory devil's-advocate stress test.
